title: Exponents and Exponential Functions | Algebra I, Unit 7 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Exponent rules, zero and negative exponents, rational exponents and radicals, scientific notation, exponential functions and their graphs, growth and decay models, and geometric sequences. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
